title: Who owns the Global South, what kind of multipolarity, and whether the rules-based order is dead
question: Three linked disputes in the 2025-07 to 2026-11 corpus: who speaks for the Global South (and whether China is its member or its leader); whether multipolarity brings order or blocs; and how Chinese voices read the 'middle powers' moment after Carney's Davos 2026 speech, against the official counter-terms.

subdisputes.title: A. Who owns the Global South
subdisputes.question: Is China a member of, a leader of, or a squeezer of the Global South, and is India a co-member or a rival claimant?

camps.name: Official: China is a natural member, and the one that unites and leads
camps.who: MFA, Xi's letters and talks, central portals, state media
camps.summary_en: Official text pairs 'largest developing country' with 'member of the Global South', calls China a 'natural' or 'rightful' member, and in its own summaries says China 'unites and leads' the Global South. India is addressed as a fellow 'important member', never as a rival.

quotes.speaker: diplomacy: Xi letter to the GDI 5th-anniversary dialogue

quotes.en: As the largest developing country and a member of the Global South, China is ready to work with all parties

quotes.speaker: commentary: diplomacy (MFA vice minister 苗得雨), carried by commentary site
quotes.title: 外交部：全球南方群体性的崛起不可阻挡，少数国家垄断国际事务的时代已经一去不返
quotes.zh: 作为全球南方的天然成员，中国始终心系全球南方、扎根全球南方
quotes.en: As a natural member of the Global South, China has always kept the Global South at heart and stayed rooted in it

quotes.speaker: state_media
quotes.title: 执大象 天下往——2026年上半年中国元首外交纪实

quotes.title: 深学笃行习近平外交思想 奋力开创中国特色大国外交新局面（2026-08-12）

camps.name: Commentary: India as a rival claimant and a 'bridge' to the West
camps.who: Guancha columnists and interviewees (刘宗义, 雁默, a Pakistani contributor)
camps.summary_en: Commentary reads India's Global South advocacy as competitive: India casts itself as the South's spokesman and as a bridge to the US and the West, and on many issues aims at China rather than at the US.

quotes.title: 观察新德里峰会，需先厘清两个关键事实

quotes.en: India has indeed long tried to position itself as the bridge between the Global South and the US-led West

quotes.speaker: commentary: 刘宗义 (interview)
quotes.title: 观察新德里峰会，需先厘清两个关键事实
quotes.zh: 在很多具体问题上，印度所针对的实际上更多是中国，而不是美国
quotes.en: On many concrete issues, what India is really aiming at is China more than the US

quotes.speaker: commentary: 沙希德·哈什马特 (Pakistani contributor)
quotes.title: 沙希德·哈什马特：王毅外长南亚三国行，释放了多个信号
quotes.zh: 印度一直谋求主导该运动，并将自身塑造为“全球南方”的领导者
quotes.en: India has always sought to dominate the [Non-Aligned] movement and to cast itself as the leader of the 'Global South'

quotes.title: 雁默：印度怕中国“木马屠城”，中国怕印度“城屠木马”

camps.name: The 'China squeeze' charge and the official rebuttal
camps.who: MFA (毛宁), MOFCOM (鄢东), NDRC (李超), relayed by 科技日报, 新华, 求是, Guancha
camps.summary_en: Reported charge (Peterson Institute / Arvind Subramanian, Foreign Affairs): Chinese manufacturing takes the industrialisation ladder away from the Global South. Every official voice answers with flat denial and motive attribution: it is the 'China threat theory' in new form, meant to drive a wedge between China and developing countries.

quotes.speaker: commentary: 苏奎 (columnist), describing the charge
quotes.title: 居心叵测！“中国挤压”是印度学者的最新离间话术-苏奎
quotes.zh: 并“挤占”了全球南方国家在中低端制造方面的发展空间
quotes.en: [The claim is that China] also 'crowds out' the room for Global South countries to develop in low- and mid-end manufacturing

quotes.speaker: state_media (科技日报) quoting MFA spokesperson 毛宁
quotes.title: 正听丨炮制“中国挤压论”，这又是一出什么戏
quotes.zh: 所谓中国挤压显然不符合事实，全球南方国家也不会认同
quotes.en: The so-called China squeeze is plainly not factual, and Global South countries will not accept it

quotes.speaker: state_media (科技日报 commentary, 张梦然)
quotes.title: 正听丨炮制“中国挤压论”，这又是一出什么戏
quotes.zh: 试图在发展中国家之间打进楔子
quotes.en: [The authors] are trying to drive a wedge among developing countries

quotes.speaker: commentary site relaying MOFCOM vice minister 鄢东
quotes.title: 商务部回应某些国家炮制的“中国挤压论”
quotes.zh: 企图破坏中国同全球南方国家合作
quotes.en: [The China-squeeze theory] seeks to sabotage China's cooperation with Global South countries

quotes.speaker: state_media (科技日报) quoting NDRC spokesperson 李超
quotes.title: “中国挤压”论是对中国的又一次抹黑
quotes.zh: 是基于零和博弈，对中国的又一次攻击抹黑
quotes.en: [The China squeeze] rests on zero-sum thinking and is one more smear against China

camps.name: Dissent inside the Chinese debate: do not just deny it
camps.who: Economist 姚洋 (Tsinghua Wudaokou forum, via Guancha)
camps.summary_en: One Chinese economist argues flat denial is a trap and that developing countries really do feel China's pressure; the official rebuttals never concede this.

quotes.title: “对方给我们下套，为什么要往里钻？”
quotes.zh: 发展中国家现在也感觉到中国的压力
quotes.en: Developing countries now also feel pressure from China

quotes.speaker: commentary site reporting 姚洋 (economist)
quotes.title: “对方给我们下套，为什么要往里钻？”
quotes.zh: 长期来说，这会对中国国际空间形成挤压
quotes.en: In the long run this will squeeze China's own international room

subdisputes.title: B. What kind of multipolarity
subdisputes.question: Does multipolarity bring a fairer order or a world of rival blocs, and how does official text answer the worry?

camps.name: Official: multipolarity, but 'equal and orderly'
camps.who: 15th FYP proposal, Xi at the SCO+ meeting (Sept 2026), joint statements, MFA
camps.summary_en: Official text never uses the bare word as a goal. It attaches 平等有序 and pairs it with 普惠包容的经济全球化, and in the September 2026 SCO+ speech Xi asks outright 'what kind of multipolarity does the world need?', answering that bloc politics and a condominium of a few powers are not real multilateralism.

quotes.speaker: central: CPC Central Committee proposal for the 15th Five-Year Plan
quotes.title: 中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议
quotes.zh: 倡导平等有序的世界多极化、普惠包容的经济全球化
quotes.en: Advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and an inclusive economic globalisation that benefits all

quotes.speaker: central: Xi, speech at the SCO+ meeting (full text)
quotes.title: 习近平在“上海合作组织+”会议上的讲话（全文）
quotes.zh: 世界需要怎样的多极化？各国如何参与和推动多极化？
quotes.en: What kind of multipolarity does the world need? How should countries take part in and advance it?

quotes.speaker: central: Xi, speech at the SCO+ meeting (full text)
quotes.title: 习近平在“上海合作组织+”会议上的讲话（全文）
quotes.zh: 一国独霸、几方共治、集团政治不是真正的多边主义
quotes.en: One-power hegemony, rule by a few, and bloc politics are not genuine multilateralism

quotes.speaker: central: Xi, speech at the SCO+ meeting (full text)
quotes.title: 习近平在“上海合作组织+”会议上的讲话（全文）
quotes.zh: 均衡有序、遵守法治是必然要求
quotes.en: Balance, order and the rule of law are essential requirements

quotes.speaker: diplomacy: Han Zheng at the 81st UNGA general debate
quotes.title: 韩正出席第81届联合国大会一般性辩论并发表讲话（2026-09-27）
quotes.zh: 摒弃冷战思维、阵营对抗
quotes.en: Abandon Cold War thinking and bloc confrontation

quotes.speaker: central (feature on the BRICS summit, SASTIND portal)
quotes.title: 推动金砖合作实现大发展、展现大作为——写在习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤之际
quotes.zh: 各国人民企盼的，不是“新冷战”，不是“小圈子”
quotes.en: What the world's peoples hope for is not a 'new Cold War', not 'small cliques'

camps.name: Commentary: multipolar is not the same as orderly
camps.who: Guancha interviews and translated foreign voices (Sachs, 张维为, 乐文特, Mearsheimer, 周波)
camps.summary_en: Commentary debates the bare concept: the world is already multipolar but has no multilateral order; the danger is fragmentation into sealed blocs; some foresee two armed camps, while 周波 rejects the 'new Cold War' label itself.

quotes.speaker: commentary: Jeffrey Sachs in dialogue with 张维为
quotes.title: 张维为对话萨克斯：让北京或上海成为联合国主要机构所在地-张维为、杰弗里·萨克斯

quotes.en: Today's world is a multipolar world, but not a multilateral one

quotes.speaker: commentary: 张维为 (host) to Sachs
quotes.title: 张维为对话萨克斯：让北京或上海成为联合国主要机构所在地-张维为、杰弗里·萨克斯
quotes.zh: 多极化其实已经存在了，但多极世界秩序尚未形成
quotes.en: Multipolarity already exists, but a multipolar world order has not yet formed

quotes.speaker: commentary: 乐文特 (former Hungarian consul-general in Shanghai)

quotes.en: The biggest risk is not multipolarity itself but that a multipolar world may split into competing, mutually isolated blocs

reading.claim: The qualified form 平等有序的世界多极化 is official and state-media vocabulary (central 27, state media 54, sub-national 47, party theory 11, diplomacy 4) and rare in commentary (8); its twin 普惠包容的经济全球化 tracks it (central 36, state media 67, sub-national 52, commentary 12). It is in the 15th FYP proposal (12650888, 2025-10-28).
reading.label: measured

reading.claim: Xi's 1 Sept 2026 SCO+ speech is titled after the qualifier and explicitly poses 'what kind of multipolarity', naming 'rule by a few' and 'bloc politics' as what it is not; 17 titles across central, party, state media and sub-national repeat the question.

reading.claim: 'New Cold War' is almost entirely a commentary word (26 titles) and appears in official text only negated ('not a new Cold War', 2 central titles); official text prefers 冷战思维 / 阵营对抗 as things to 'abandon' or 'oppose'.

reading.claim: No document in any speaker type pairs multipolarity with disorder (无序/混乱/失序 within 30 characters): a measured null. The fragmentation worry is voiced through 'blocs' and 'not multilateral', not 'disorder'.

reading.claim: Official text never concedes that multipolarity itself carries risk; risk is always attributed to hegemony, bloc politics or Cold War thinking by others. The qualifier 平等有序 reads as the official answer to the commentary worry (multipolar but not multilateral, bloc fragmentation).
reading.label: inferred

subdisputes.title: C. Middle powers and the 'rules-based order'
subdisputes.question: How do Chinese voices read Carney's Davos 2026 claim that the rules-based order is over and his call for middle powers to unite, and what counter-terms does official text use?

camps.name: Commentary: Carney confirms the US-led order is finished
camps.who: Guancha columnists (晨枫, 韩笑鹏, 翟东升)
camps.summary_en: Commentary takes Carney's speech as a Western confession: the 'rules-based order' was always a fiction and the US itself is ending it.

quotes.speaker: commentary: 晨枫 (columnist), quoting Carney
quotes.title: 晨枫：准入加拿大的中国电车，是假装鲶鱼的鲸鱼
quotes.zh: 卡尼在演讲中称，“基于规则的旧秩序已终结，且将一去不返”
quotes.en: Carney said in his speech that 'the old rules-based order has ended and will not return'

quotes.speaker: commentary: 韩笑鹏 (columnist), quoting Carney
quotes.title: 韩笑鹏：2026年的冬季达沃斯，西方自己打了个“冷战”
quotes.zh: 所谓的‘基于规则的国际秩序’，其实是虚假的
quotes.en: the so-called 'rules-based international order' was in fact false

quotes.speaker: commentary: 韩笑鹏 (columnist)
quotes.title: 韩笑鹏：2026年的冬季达沃斯，西方自己打了个“冷战”
quotes.zh: 这是对所有中等强国的警告
quotes.en: This is a warning to all middle powers

quotes.speaker: commentary: 翟东升 (scholar)
quotes.title: 翟东升：那个所谓“基于规则”的国际秩序正在被美国人亲手终结
quotes.zh: 那个所谓基于规则的国际秩序正在被美国人亲手终结
quotes.en: That so-called rules-based international order is being ended by the Americans with their own hands

camps.name: Commentary: but Carney's middle powers are still the West
camps.who: 张维为 and Fudan China Institute colleagues; 黄平 via Guancha
camps.summary_en: The skeptical reading: Carney's 'third way' is a club of Western middle powers defending Western interests; China's realistic goal is that middle powers do not pick sides.

quotes.speaker: commentary: 张维为 (Fudan China Institute)

quotes.zh: 他所讲的“中等强国”仍然是指西方国家
quotes.en: The 'middle powers' he talks about still means Western countries

quotes.speaker: commentary: 张维为 (Fudan China Institute)
quotes.title: 张维为《这就是中国》323期|“卡尼主义”：第三条道路？-张维为、范勇鹏
quotes.zh: 他骨子里还是要捍卫西方国家的所谓“共同利益”
quotes.en: At bottom he still wants to defend the so-called 'common interests' of Western countries

quotes.speaker: commentary: 戴维来 (Fudan China Institute)
quotes.title: 张维为《这就是中国》第336集：中等强国的崛起-张维为、戴维来
quotes.zh: 它们就是集体走向“C”位的“中等强国”
quotes.en: They are the 'middle powers', moving together to centre stage

camps.name: Official: no 'middle powers', no 'rules-based order'; the UN and international law instead
camps.who: Xi's talks and joint statements, People's Daily commentary, MFA
camps.summary_en: Official text does not take up 中等强国 or Carney's diagnosis. It answers with its own pair, 'the UN-centred international system and the international-law-based international order', treats 'rules-based' as a US code for rules that suit the US, and reads Carney's visit as a bilateral reset only.

The only central use of 基于规则的 in the window is the BRICS New Delhi Declaration on the WTO trading system, i.e. rules-based trade, never a rules-based order.
reading.label: measured

reading.claim: Official text answers with 以联合国为核心的国际体系 (central 19, diplomacy 7, state media 42) and 以国际法为基础的国际秩序 (central 19, diplomacy 3, state media 33); commentary uses these far less than it uses 基于规则.
reading.label: measured

reading.claim: Carney appears in official/state text (central 3, state media 11) only as a bilateral counterpart or trade-war actor; no official or state-media text in the scan repeats his 'order is dead' claim.
reading.label: measured

reading.claim: Xi's July 2024 use of 中等强国 (Kazakhstan) is asserted by CASS but the source readout is not in the corpus.
reading.label: unverified

reading.claim: Official silence on 'middle powers' is deliberate: the category would sort states by power tier, cutting across the 'Global South' grouping China claims to belong to and lead, and Carney's middle-power coalition is, as 张维为 notes, a Western one.
reading.label: inferred
